mapper.select: select count(*) as tot_cnt from user
select count(*) as tot_cnt from media where 1=1 and media_div = 1
select count(*) as tot_cnt from media where 1=1 and media_div = 2
select row_number() over(order by board_id desc) as num , board_id , title , writer , save_date from board

select a.* from ( select row_number() over() as num , media_name , media_div , genre , open_date , save_date from media where 1=1 and save_date < date_format(now(), '%Y%m%d') order by save_date desc ) a limit 5

select comment_id, type, name, writer, comment, assess_rate, save_date from ( ( select comment_id , 'media' as type , b.media_name as name , writer , content as comment , assess_rate , ifnull(a.update_date, a.save_date) as save_date from media_comment a, media b where a.media_id = b.media_id ) union ( select comment_id , 'community' as type , '' as name , writer , comment , 0 as assess_rate , save_date from comment ) ) a order by save_date desc limit 10
